title: Jarnail Singh v. Lachhmi Narain Gupta

content.caseIdentity: Jarnail Singh v. Lachhmi Narain Gupta, (2018) 10 SCC 396
content.holding: 5-judge Bench held that quantifiable data on backwardness for SC/STs violates Indra Sawhney; however, Creamy Layer applies to SCs/STs in promotion reservations.
content.relevance: Application of creamy layer to SCs/STs in promotions.

evidence.note: 5-Judge Constitution Bench judgment in SLP (C) No. 30621 of 2011; 2018 INSC 870; (2018) 10 SCC 396.
